title: PDF Research Reader — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Searches, analyzes, and extracts information from PDF documents. The PDF Research Reader searches, analyzes, and extracts information from PDFs. It reads the full document text including tables, searches for terms with context snippets, extracts tables into usable data, and answers questions grounded in the document's own pages. Page numbers travel with every extracted fact so nothing loses its source.
capabilities: Read full PDF text including tables
Search terms with context snippets
Extract tables into usable data
Answer questions grounded in the document
Attach page numbers to every extracted fact

demo.code: const docs=[{id:1,text:'spaced repetition improves recall'},{id:2,text:'massed practice is weaker'},{id:3,text:'sleep aids memory'}];const hits=docs.filter(d=>d.text.includes('repetition')).map(d=>d.id);J({hits});assert(JSON.stringify(hits)==='[1]','search');
